limitations: Live execution requires the existing Rakazo service, its configured DeepSeek provider, the original checkout's authenticated session and .env, and the selected application's dependencies; no replacement configuration or model fixtures are supplied.

Rakazo runs agents remotely. No remote-side recording/export entrypoint is supplied, so parent-process capture covers local MCP execution and any app-owned visible-message observations, not remote model execution internals.
Report rendering can invoke a PDF subprocess. No child-side recording/export entrypoint is supplied for that renderer; local callback observations do not record effects inside the child.
The fixed MCP port 8766 and shared Rakazo team require serial episodes with Docker-to-host connectivity; concurrent samples would conflict.
validation: Syntax, retained helper definitions and assertions; no execution or semantic equivalence claim.
